title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I married a girl on 18.9.2005 at 2 P. M. on Sunday. It was a registry marriege not a conventional social marriege. On my side, only I was present and I had no witness. On the girl side her father, mother, meternal uncle and an aged relative were present. My question is whether the marriege was legal according to Islamic Law as I had no witness? and whether the time was inauspicious? 2278 views Q. It is necessary to pay the fixed mahr 3684 views Q. NIkah 1936 views Q. Is Jahez lawful 11899 views Q. I am a Sunni Muslim. I met a wife of a non-Muslim. She was physically tortured by her husband. To get rid of that situation, I helped her. Her husband came to know. Situation became worse. Ultimately, they got divorced. In between, I fall in love with her and commit illegal sexual intercourse with her 3-4 times. After that I felt the guilt. In the shake of that, I became religious and ask forgiveness from Allah. She reverted to Muslim and became religious too. We both got 100 lashes as per hadith each. I want to marry her so that Allah may forgive both of us for the gravest sin. But my family is in strict opposition. Her parents have no objection. To perform Namaz and Roza and to follow Islam, she is staying in hostel. If she returns to her home, she cannot follow Islam. She has no earnings. As I did not marry her still, her parents is blaming Muslim and force her to go back to her previous husband. Please suggest me. 4356 views Q. Mahr related 4958 views Q. Nikah 2112 views Q. Mahr 2284 views Q. Dealing with a wife who has separated from husband without husband's consent and taking away the kids 3530 views Q. As salamu Allikum. I have express my interest to marry one girl whose father is Bnak employee. Besides it, they are very much follower of Islam. Before I express my interest, through ISTIKARA I saw her in my dreams (she is my nighbour). At first, my mother reject her but after knowing my view she give her consent to marry this girl. Now tell me is it wise to marry her or not? 2027 views Q. If the person who held nikah sermony , knows that , guy is homosexsual and fornikater , while bride is pure virgin muslim girl , then the nikah will be legal or not. 3656 views Q. I would like to know solution to the following mas'ala under the light of Qur'anul Kareem and Ahadithun Nabavi sallallah alaihiwasallam. A couple got married (Nikah) long ago (say 40 years ago) with a MEHR of certain amount for example Rs. 5000/-. Till date he has not paid the MEHR. Now he wants to pay the MEHR to his wife. The mas'alah is should he pay the MEHR of Rs. 5000/- or any other way. 2051 views Q. My question is that my wife delivered a kid two months back and so far i have not been in sexual contact with her thinking that kid is with us and this is not good to have infront of the two month kid and also with another reason that if we have intercourse then before ghusl might be she will feed the baby because no one knows when baby will feel hungry for milk so please let me know if i can have intercourse with my wife infront of my kid while the baby is sleeping and can she breast feed the baby before ghusl. 5690 views Q. If husband and wife do not do sex, in how many days their Nikah will be broken? 110094 views Q. Taubah 2397 views
